name: sakhawat-designer-portfolio
description: Production-Ready Full-Stack Designer Portfolio, Client Portal & Admin CMS for Md Sakhawat Hossain

scripts.dev:all: concurrently "node --watch server.js" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd client && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.postinstall: npm run build && npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss && node prisma/seed.js
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install

author: Md Sakhawat Hossain
